text: Four companies win 2026 sugar import quota auction
HÀ NỘI - Four companies have been awarded a combined 75,000 tonnes of sugar import tariff quotas for 2026 through an auction.
The council for allocating 2026 sugar import tariff quotas recently held the auction under HS code 17.01.
According to the auction results, five traders submitted applications to register for 2026 sugar import tariff quotas.
Of these, four submitted complete and valid applications and bidding forms, qualifying for quota allocation.

The four successful bidders were Viet Nam Sugar Joint Stock Company, which received a quota of 20,000 tonnes; Thanh Thanh Cong - Bien Hoa Joint Stock Company, with 20,000 tonnes; Lam Son Sugar Cane Joint Stock Corporation at 15,000 tonnes; and AgriS Ninh Hoa Import Export Joint Stock Company, with 20,000 tonnes.
The total volume allocated through the auction was 75,000 tonnes, equivalent to 53.95 per cent of the 139,000-tonne sugar import tariff quota announced for the year. - VNS
